recommendation: Keep this source fix as the bounded completion of FHIR-18575. Do not treat it as resolving the broader FHIR-51614 translation guidance request.
issue_request: FHIR-18575 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core ValueSet. It asked whether the implied designation.use value "primary code/designation" was actually in the designation-use value set and resolved to use wording with "primary designation".
initial_application: Commit 4907f9bcb0b710cb2837a93a20c4b23210a37249 was the recorded application, but it only changed "of" to "meaning" and left "primary code/designation" in the narrative; later current sources still had "primary code" in ValueSet narrative and StructureDefinition comment.
additional_context: FHIR-18637 is the CodeSystem duplicate of FHIR-18575. FHIR-38834 later accepted the same wording change for CodeSystem.concept.designation. FHIR-51614 is a later Triaged broader guidance issue and remains undecided.
reconciliation: Changed source/valueset/valueset-notes.xml and source/valueset/structuredefinition-ValueSet.xml from "primary code" wording to "primary designation". ValueSet is active in source/fhir.ini.
source_changes: source/valueset/valueset-notes.xml: changed the active ValueSet designations narrative from "primary code" to "primary designation".
source/valueset/structuredefinition-ValueSet.xml: changed the ValueSet.compose.include.concept.designation comment from "primary code" to "primary designation".
